classes.name: ControllerUserUser
classes.description: Controller class responsible for user management in the OpenCart admin interface, including listing, form handling, saving, and deleting users.

methods.name: form
methods.description: Displays the user form for adding or editing a user, pre-populating data if editing, and handling request filters and permissions.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Processes form submissions for creating or updating a user, performs validation, permission checks, and returns JSON responses indicating success or errors.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Handles deletion of selected users based on POST data, with permission checks and JSON response.

methods.name: authorize
methods.description: Outputs authorization management interface or data based on user permissions.

methods.name: getAuthorize
methods.description: Fetches authorization data for a specific user, including authorization tokens, IPs, user agents, statuses, and delete links; supports pagination.

methods.name: deleteAuthorize
methods.description: Deletes a specific authorization record, enforces permission checks, handles token/session validation, and responds with JSON.

methods.name: login
methods.description: Handles user login process, loads login interface or data.

methods.name: getLogin
methods.description: Retrieves login logs for a specific user, includes pagination, date formatting, and separate view rendering.

methods.name: getLogin
methods.description: Fetches login history data for a user, including IP address, user agent, and date, with pagination support.

methods.name: autocomplete
methods.description: Provides an autocomplete feature for user search, filtering by username, name, and email, returning sorted JSON data for interface.
